run_golden_addition_part_clip_name: run the script to generate CLIP text embeddings for golden addition part categories and save as numpy array
run_clip_text_embeddings: run the script with --prompt photo to generate CLIP text embeddings using 'a photo of a {}' prompt templates
run_clip_embeddings_custom_model: run the script with --clip_model ViT-B/32 to generate CLIP text embeddings using a vision transformer model
run_clip_embeddings_no_prefix: run the script with --prompt none to generate CLIP text embeddings without any text prefix
run_clip_embeddings_save_output: run the script with --out_path to save generated CLIP text features as a numpy file
